channel.title: ThreatReel
channel.description: Threats abound everywhere across the cybersecurity landscape! The ThreatReel Podcast digs deep into the threats impacting enterprise environments and home networks. Join us as we discuss the latest information security news around threats including the actors, the hunting, the intelligence, the modeling, and beyond!

item.title: 2021 RSA Conference Preview | ThreatReel S01E02
item.itunes:summary: Matt Scheurer and Micah K. Brown preview the upcoming 2021 RSA Conference. Micah discusses his upcoming presentation at RSA titled “WAF Made Easy”, including teasers for his talk. This leads to conversations about Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), why they are important, and how they differ from a conventional network firewall.
item.description: In this episode of ThreatReel, Matt Scheurer and Micah K. Brown preview the upcoming 2021 RSA Conference. Micah discusses his upcoming presentation at RSA titled “WAF Made Easy”, including teasers for his talk. Matt and Micah converse about Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), why they are important, and how they differ from a conventional network firewall. The host also discuss attending RSA and getting the most out of attending a security or hacker conference.

item.title: HAFNIUM, Then and Now | ThreatReel S01E01
item.itunes:summary: Matt Scheurer and Micah K. Brown discuss HAFNIUM. Topics include details around the original Microsoft Exchange vulnerabilities and malicious web shell exploits, mitigation strategies, indicators of compromise, threat hunting strategies, and file integrity monitoring. Discussions then shift towards Microsoft Defender ATP mitigations, and the FBI exploiting vulnerabilities to currently compromised mail servers to clean them of unwanted web shells.

item.title: Introducing the ThreatReel Podcast | ThreatReel Pilot Episode S01E00
item.itunes:summary: Matt Scheurer and Micah K. Brown preview the upcoming ThreatReel Podcast. Learn more about the show hosts as they discuss their background in Cybersecurity and more.
item.description: In this unofficial pilot episode of ThreatReel, hosts Matt Scheurer and Micah K. Brown discuss their backgrounds and the journeys from their small town Ohio roots to their ascension in speaking at numerous prominent and prestigious security conferences across the country. Matt and Micah reminisce and share some of their favorite memorable conference and meetup group moments. The hosts talk about the events that brought them to work together and giving back to their local information security community through sharing knowledge and mentoring others. They discuss the show inspirations, music, and future plans for ThreatReel.
